pos.personaBrief: Liverpool averaged 60%+ possession and Alisson said the team worked more on possession and control than in 2017/18, yet Klopp rejects possession for its own sake and wins through counter-pressing transitions.

pro.personaBrief: Alisson's long passes and back-to-front incisiveness, plus a vertical front three, show a direct bent, though the team was more controlled than in 2017/18.

est.personaBrief: Organised chaos: Firmino dropping, Salah and Mane moving inside, number eights running forward and fluid roles, with a fixed base shape.

lar.personaBrief: Attacks relied on full-backs high and wide (Alexander-Arnold and Robertson among top assist providers) while Salah and Mane cut inside as a narrow front line.

blo.personaBrief: Gegenpressing with a high line is the core of Klopp's identity, although the press was somewhat less relentless in 2018/19; counter-press forced many turnovers in advanced areas.

mar.personaBrief: Klopp moved away from Dortmund man-marking to zonal solutions; the only 2018/19 corner evidence is a weak zonal and man hybrid.

pla.personaBrief: Strong own identity (gegenpress, front three), with tactical tweaks such as the 4-2-3-1 in autumn but largely the same approach against everyone.

res.personaBrief: 97 points and the Champions League with a more measured, consistent approach; Klopp wants fighting, loud football but the season was defined by results and avoiding draws.

sis.personaBrief: Stars Salah, Mane and Firmino all pressed and worked for the collective; Klopp's system lifts players, with a lighthouse midfield and tactical duties for all.

jog.personaBrief: Intensity and athleticism were basic requirements, with no classic number 10, but Fabinho and Wijnaldum were valued for passing and reading the game, not just for power.

bas.personaBrief: Squad built through signings (Fabinho, Keita, Alisson, Van Dijk) at prime ages with some academy debuts (Hoever, Jones); young players were integrated gradually.

lid.personaBrief: Klopp built a united group (even the backup goalkeeper stayed a professional), listened to leaders and cared for people, with the same rules for everyone.
